steps.title: Determine whether the record is in the current set or has been archived to robot task activity
steps.purpose: Classify the tote task as still current or already archived, using the source-described pattern of one current and one archived dataset/table.
steps.instruction: Using the source-described behavior (one current and one archived), determine whether the tote task record you located is part of the current Robot Task set or has moved to the archived Robot Task Activity.
